SessionStart.bash: common=$(git rev-parse --path-format=absolute --git-common-dir 2>/dev/null) || exit 0; root=$(dirname "$common"); script="$root/.copilot/hooks/session-context.sh"; [ -f "$script" ] || exit 0; bash "$script" copilot
SessionStart.powershell: $c = git rev-parse --path-format=absolute --git-common-dir 2>$null; if (-not $c) { exit 0 }; $s = Join-Path (Split-Path $c -Parent) '.copilot/hooks/session-context.sh'; if (-not (Test-Path $s)) { exit 0 }; try { bash ($s -replace '\\','/') copilot } catch { exit 0 }
